title: A poem Saved
author: Vandana Kumar
text:
If there is one thing that has to be done
In haste
Like with an urgency
As if, your existence depended on it

Like an emergency call at 3am
Someone needs an ambulance
A bottle of blood
That sort of emergency

If there is one thing that has to be done
Now
It`s to find a way
To un-teach the hate

And yes I know you will say
Hatred in wombs for ages
Is now festered
The damage done
The tragedy of doing too little
Or too much of the wrong things
And calling it education
